steps.content: You see a crack in the chaotic battlespace. As you make for it, three filthy monsters pounce on you.
Red beams burst out of your right hand. You blow the enemies up with your power, and make a hole in the wall of contamination in front of you.
The side effect of forcing a blast comes shortly. But you have no time for that; you hurry into the conference hall...
Spikes dot Zoya's body, as if she has just gone through a brutal execution. Head hanging low, she shows no reaction whatsoever to your entering.

She is murmuring. Her eyes are aimless, her voice is hoarse, and her fist that smashed the ground is cracked. Marks of Mania is binding her body and searing her soul. You know she is still fighting, fighting with all her might against the filthy presence that has invaded her consciousness.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You don't stand a chance... Not a chance... I will not lose... I will not lose...

options: Zoya, I'm here to fight with you.

steps.content: You reach out for her, trying to awaken her with the shackles.
But right at this moment, Zoya raises her head, purple flames burning in her eyes, and her murderous malice devours you at once.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Do not touch me... Go to hell!!
You sustain a mighty punch in the chest and are sent flying backwards a few meters. Nightmare catches you, and you spit out blood.
Through your hazy vision, you see a red patch of flesh, moist and mushy, clinging to her right shoulder. The patch of flesh cracks, and a lone eye pops open, staring at you like a black hole.
She is mine... mine... Whatever she wants, I can provide...!
Hahaha... Just like this... Fight, Zoya... Destroy everything in front of you, fight on... This is the source of your power, your true self...
What it craves is you, you in this state...
